title: つき と たいよう
jp: た行 ・ gojuon row 4 ・ nature

render.trackName: つき と たいよう

blurb: The outdoors: the sun and tall bamboo, a mountain waterfall, dew on a flower, the night moon and the blue earth. A calm nature cut of three た-row songs (home · nature · animals).
concept: Words alone blend (findings F-10), so every target sits in a small image — やま の たき, はな の つゆ, あおい ちきゅう — and it recombines with earlier rows (あさ, やま, そら, はな, あおい, あかい return), keeping the ladder (F-13).
The five-kana row た ち つ て と closes every verse as the sung-together refrain (F-07). The 3-minute cut adds a day-in-nature bridge and a sentences-only review, not a loop (F-12).

This is the nature variation — the calm one, for a koto × modern arrangement. た行 has the sky-and-earth words (たいよう, つき, つち, ちきゅう) that suit a quiet, wide feel. Honest note: ち and て are thin rows, so they lean on a butterfly, the earth, a ladybug and a mountain temple.
